channel.title: CIS 501 - Software Architecture and Design :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Course Description Principles and patterns for design and structure of software, development of object-oriented models, examples of software architecture. Credit Hours 3 credits Course Overview Not yet drafted — pending course-designer’s detailed pass. resources/reference/degree-maps/cs.md notes this course will “probably [shift] focus to incorporate more AI usage as a development tool.” It’s also the confirmed host for the Professional Practices lens’s professional-communication pass (presenting and defending a design to an audience, individually assessed even when the design was a team effort) — see content/core-design/lenses/lens-professional-practices.md. This is also the course a dedicated acceptance-testing elective is planned to sit alongside for the Software Architecture specialization (not yet drafted).
